title: Unit – 1 : Session – 4 : SLO – 1  |  Self-Referential Structures and Structure Pointers — Match the Following
sections: I. Match the Following
1. Self-referential structure — P. Has a pointer to the same structure type.
2. Linked list node — O. Data + pointer.
3. malloc — L. Allocates memory.
4. -> operator — R. Access pointer member (ptr->member).
5. . operator — M. Access normal structure member.
6. Dynamic node creation — T. malloc(sizeof(struct Node)).
7. List head — N. First node pointer.
8. Node traversal — K. Loop using pointer.
9. Null pointer check — J. if (ptr != NULL).
10. Free memory — S. free(ptr).
11. Circular list — H. Last node points to first.
12. Doubly linked list — C. Prev and next pointers.
13. Memory leak — E. No free() called.
14. sizeof — G. Gets memory size.
15. Data field access — B. ptr->data.
16. Insertion at head — A. New node before head.
17. List deletion — I. Adjust pointers, free memory.
18. List length — D. Traverse and count nodes.
19. Node allocation check — Q. ptr == NULL (malloc failed).
20. Last node check — F. ptr->next == NULL.
